# detect

Imported as `@elffuss/ai/detect`, `@elffuss/ai/detect/sizes`.

## `sdk/detect/decode.js`

Decoding the raw outputs of RF-DETR. The model scores every class of every query with its own sigmoid: there is no softmax and no "no object" class. The generic DETR post-processing of Transformers.js drops the last class as background and uses a softmax, which gives wrong scores for this model, so its outputs are decoded here. Pure functions: no runtime, no DOM.

### `DEFAULT_THRESHOLD`

Default minimum score of a detection.

### Type `DetectBox`

```ts
{ xmin: number, ymin: number, xmax: number, ymax: number }
```

Corners in pixels of the image as it was decoded (EXIF orientation applied).

### Type `DetectedObject`

```ts
{ label: string, score: number, box: DetectBox }
```

`label` is the model's class name, in English; `score` goes from 0 to 1.

### Type `RawTensor`

```ts
{ dims: number[], data: ArrayLike<number> }
```

### `sigmoid(x)`

The logistic function.

### `logitOf(p)`

The logit whose sigmoid is `p`: comparing raw logits with it gives the same
answer as comparing scores with `p`, without a sigmoid per class.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `p` | `number` |  |

### `clampThreshold(t)`

A usable threshold: a number between 0 and 1, or the default.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `t` | `unknown` |  |

### `labelList(id2label, numClasses)`

Class names by class index. `id2label` maps ids (as strings) to names; ids may
be sparse (COCO numbers its 80 classes from 1 to 90), so the list has a hole
wherever the model has a class without a name.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `id2label` | `Record<string, string>` |  |
| `numClasses` | `number` |  |

Returns `(string\|undefined)[]`.

### `logitShape(dims)`

Queries and classes of a logits tensor shaped [1, queries, classes] or [queries, classes].

### `cornerBox(cx, cy, w, h, width, height)`

Box of one query in pixels: the model gives the centre, width and height as
fractions of the image; the corners are clamped to the image.

Returns `DetectBox\|null`: null when the box is empty or not a number

### `decodeDetections({ logits, boxes, labels, threshold = DEFAULT_THRESHOLD, width, height })`

Objects found by RF-DETR, from its raw outputs.
For each query, the best class that has a name; kept when its score reaches
the threshold. Sorted by score, highest first.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `o` | `{ logits: RawTensor, boxes: RawTensor, labels: (string\|undefined)[], threshold?: number, width: number, height: number }` | `boxes` is shaped [1, queries, 4] (centre x, centre y, width, height, as fractions); `width` and `height` are the size of the image the boxes are given in. |

Returns `DetectedObject[]`.

## `sdk/detect/impl.js`

Where the detector runs (a Worker, or the page with worker: false). The Transformers.js pipeline of the model, fed by the model store, gives its image processor and its ONNX model; the pipeline's own post-processing is not used (see decode.js). Each run decodes the image, resizes it once with a high-quality filter to the model's input, lets the processor turn it into a tensor, runs the model and decodes the boxes at the size of the image the caller gave. Never fetches, never touches the DOM.

### `DECODE_MAX_SIDE`

Longest side an image is decoded at before the resize to the model's input.
Larger photos are scaled down first, which keeps the memory of one run small.

### `inputSize(size)`

The model's input size from its image processor (RF-DETR Nano: 384 × 384).

### `forward(state, img)`

The model's raw outputs for one decoded image (see decodeImage): `logits`
shaped [1, queries, classes] and `boxes` shaped [1, queries, 4]. The caller
disposes them.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `state` | `{ tf: any, pipe: any, size: { width: number, height: number } }` | what load() returned |
| `img` | `{ width: number, height: number, data: Uint8ClampedArray }` |  |

## `sdk/detect/index.js`

@elffuss/ai/detect: finds objects of 80 everyday kinds (the COCO classes: people, vehicles, animals, furniture, food…) in a photo or a video frame, with RF-DETR Nano, in the browser. Each object comes with its class name in English, a score from 0 to 1 and its box in pixels of the image.

### Type `DetectResult`

```ts
{ objects: import('./decode.js').DetectedObject[], width: number, height: number, device: 'webgpu'|'wasm' }
```

`width` and `height` are the size of the input image, the one the boxes are given in.

### Type `DetectRunOptions`

```ts
{ threshold?: number, signal?: AbortSignal }
```

`threshold`: minimum score of an object, from 0 to 1 (0.5 by default).

### `class Detect`

Object detection with RF-DETR Nano. One model per instance, loaded once from the
Elffuss model store; runs go one after another.

- `.constructor(options)`
- `.run(input, opts)`: Detect the objects of one image. Loads the model first if needed. The image is a Blob or File (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP or AVIF, recognised by its first bytes), an ImageBitmap or an ImageData; an image, canvas or video element is turned into an ImageBitmap on the page first.

### `detect`

Load, detect once and dispose: `detect(file, { threshold, device, onProgress })`.
Options of `new Detect()` and of `run()` can be mixed.
